def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(m)]
    ccw = [[grid[j][m - 1 - i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(m)]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[i] + cw[i] for i in range(n)] + [ccw[i] + half_turn[i] for i in range(m)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
